text:
Maya: quick sync — we're onboarding the canary comparator for the new routing policy, need to agree mapping from runtime counters to infra metrics
Tom: ok, what are the runtime counters we need?
Maya: at minimum: `req_count`, `served_qps`, `p95_latency_ms`, `p99_latency_ms`, `kv_hit_ratio`, `batch_size_avg`
Rui: infra side has `endpoint_requests`, `tokens_out`, `backend_lat_p95`, `backend_lat_p99`, and `cache_hit_rate` — some names differ but semantic matches 
Sasha: main problems: aggregation window, sampling, and label harmonization. If runtime reports per-route, infra reports per-node.
Maya: suggestion: canonicalize on these labels: `route`, `model_variant`, `region`, `canary_bucket` — everyone ok?
Tom: fine, but we need a transform layer so dashboards can compare apples-to-apples. runtime -> infra mapping: `req_count` -> `endpoint_requests`, `served_qps` -> `endpoint_requests / window_s` 
Rui: agree. for latency: runtime `p99_latency_ms` should map to `backend_lat_p99` but note infra includes network egress. we should add a `latency_source` tag: `runtime` vs `backend`
Maya: good call. Also, for `kv_hit_ratio` vs `cache_hit_rate` we should normalize to a 0..1 float and name it `cache_hit_rate` everywhere.
Sasha: about windows: dashboards team prefers 1m and 5m aggregates. runtime currently emits 30s rolling; infra is 1m. we should standardize to 1m for canary comparisons.
Tom: that implies dropping or upsampling runtime 30s -> 1m by simple sum/avg. OK.
Rui: sampling: infra has 10% sidecar sampling on traces. metrics are full-count, but we have partial logs. For quantile stability we should require at least N=100 samples per 1m window to show p99. add a note in dashboard: "insufficient samples" shading.
Maya: can we express the "insufficient samples" rule in the panel? e.g. PromQL: `absent_over_time(count_over_time(req_count[1m]) < 100)` or similar.
Sasha: yes, we'll add a threshold and show a small status tile: `sample_ok` boolean. If sample_ok=false hide p99 delta.
Tom: deltas: do we show absolute deltas or relative % change for canary vs baseline? ops wants % for cost/scale signals, runtime team prefers absolute for latency-ms.
Maya: show both — panel 1 absolute delta (canary - baseline), panel 2 percent change. Default to highlight percent > 10% or latency delta > 15ms.
Rui: alerting: we should avoid noisy alerts. Use a two-step rule: regression if sustained over 3 consecutive 1m windows AND percent change > threshold. Also suppress during rollouts with `canary_in_progress=true`.
Sasha: UX: add a small dropdown for alignment: `align by route` vs `align by model_variant`. That will flip grouping in the panels.
Maya: instrumentation contract: runtime emits `route` tag exactly as in the routing table (e.g., `/chat/completions`, `/embed`). infra must emit the same `route` label in metrics.
Tom: who owns the translation layer? infra or runtime?
Rui: infra will own a lightweight router service that translates names and exposes a metrics facade. runtime will add a compatibility shim to emit both old and canonical labels for one week.
Maya: timeline? we need this for next canary on Friday.
Rui: infra can ship the facade by Thu EOD if runtime does the shim by Wed.
Sasha: dashboard work: I'll build the panels using the facade metrics. ETA Thu noon for a first pass.
Tom: tagging: add `sample_rate` label where applicable so we can compute corrected counts.
Maya: cost concerns: telemetry ingestion spike could increase bill. we should add a sampling budget: if `route` QPS < 100 keep full cardinality, else reduce label cardinality (drop `session_id`).
Rui: we can implement cardinality rules in the facade: drop high-card labels when `qps > 500`.
Maya: final call: agreed on canonical labels, 1m window, sample_ok tile, dual-delta panels, and facade ownership by infra.
Sasha: noted — I'll create the dashboard PR and link the panel JSON.
Tom: I'll update runtime shim PR with canonical labels and sample_rate.
Rui: infra will open the facade PR and add cardinality guards.
deploy-bot: canary job started for `routing-policy-v2` (canary_bucket=10%) — link: https://deploys.local/runs/9832 :rocket:
Maya: thanks. if we hit noisy signals during this run we pause alerts and triage after the run. :thumbsup:
Sasha: dropping the panel link here when ready.
Maya: perfect, thanks team.
